description:
We are VZD TerraTech, an innovative development team building VZD (MARS//GUIDE) — a comprehensive, offline-first Martian navigation and exploration guide designed for the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge. 

Our project features real-time NASA Mars Trek MOLA mapping, a Sci-Fi tactical user interface and seamless bilingual support (Arabic & English). 

We are looking for passionate developers, designers, and space enthusiasts who want to build cutting-edge space exploration tools!
